CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 14

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 45
   C. 30
   D. 36

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

13. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
